Today we fixed bug on Cardboard house, what happened exactly? I paste the explanation by Elizabeth (House Builder player), what helped us very much:

In the Cardboard House map when placing the cardboard boxes the game will glitch and show that even though a box has been placed another one is needed to be placed in the same spot the blue outline will still show and the counter in the top right corner will not go down but it will be removed from my inventory. FAQ
1. is it compulsory to have any of the DLC's to get any of the achivements?
No! Achivements have been added to the main version of the game :)
2. How can I control the time in the gameplay to get an achivement?
From now on, there will be a countdown of gameplay time in game:

Time only counts when you are in the game. When you are in the menu, however, time stops. Therefore, even if you get distracted by something, don't worry, you can complete the level in some time and still get the achivement :D
3. Is the time to complete the levels optimal?

We have followed the gameplays of various youtubers (but also our gameplay). We took into players those who progressed through the game more slowly, but also those who progressed through the game faster. On this basis, we determined the average time it takes to complete a level. It is not exorbitant, but it is not trivial either. We think that everyone will have fun while completing the level ;)
4. What do the finds look like?
They have the appearance of a helmet. They are quite well hidden, but we think that anyone who spends a little time on the map will be able to find each oneːsteamhappyː

With the April DLC coming out, we are happy to continue developing the basic version of the game for you as well. We hope you enjoy the new level⛵️ 🗺️

There are many Islands on the ocean - many of them are uninhabited, but there are still small islands that, by their size and nature, was not sufficiently attractive for human habitation🏊‍♂️ For some strange, unexplained reason you end up on it, cut off from the world.... you do extremely well on it, but you suffer from loneliness - so you decide to build a Raft House to occasionally visit your neighbours on other islands🏠⛵️

releases.displayName: House Builder Christmas Update - House Flipper and Builder Together!

items.text: With today's update, we present to you a special update - you will be able to feel the atmosphere of the Christmas on each level!
We encourage you to purchase our Christmas Bundle with House Flipper game - you can save money:

On the occasion of the Christmas update, gifts are placed on the map, which lead to surprises. Following the path laid out by them, on some maps you can find small ⛄️snowmen⛄️ hidden behind a cluster of gifts on each map - of course, it won't be easy, there are many clusters, and only one contains a snowman. Find one and win prizes!
On the map, with the help of gifts that line the path, you can find Santa Claus. He is hiding on each map. Try to find him!

releases.displayName: House Builder UPDATE - Cardboard and Cowboy Houses!

items.text: Another update ahead - this time you'll move to the Wild West, where you'll feel like a cowboy, and build a cardboard house, which is the cheapest house you can build in House Builder! 😮⛩️
We encourage you to purchase our bundles - links can be found at the end of the post 🤓

The Wild West went down in history as an outlaw place - banks🏦, stagecoaches🐎 and trains were raided. You could be a good or bad cowboy - it was all up to you. Today, you'll be able to feel the same way - you're in the wilderness where you have to build your dream home - you'll face many of the challenges of that time - heat, loneliness and drought. You are here with animals to help you create a self-sufficient farm.🐑🐏

We are moving to the modern day. Today, homelessness is a serious problem. There are more than half a million homeless people in the United States. On the other hand, a lot of those people are able to cope in so difficult circumstances. In this level you will build a house out of cardboard - this will help us understand how to combine resourcefulness with materials we can find on the street♻️💚
We encourage you to purchase our Wild West Dynasty and Bum Simulator bundles🌅:

Hi Builders!🏗️
With today's update, we present to you the bugs we have fixed and the mechanics we have introduced:
The mechanics of selecting a pad or keyboard + mouse to play House Builder have been made: easier - now appears 'Press space to leave keyboard input, Press X to leave gamepad input';
When we have a house pin selected, selecting another house is no longer active;
Fixed messages on Bamboo House - no longer pops up message to cut down bamboos when you have an axe and not a machete;
Removed house building material that contributed nothing;
Fixed a bug with the concrete mixer in the Bungalow level;
Fixed a bug with the wheelbarrow in the Bungalow level that prevented the player's position from resetting;
Fixed a bug with a truck that prevented the level from being completed after driving through trash;
Improved the game's loading mechanics;

Improved item loading mechanics on all levels.: There are currently fewer houses on the console version than on the Steam version. This is due to the game not being fully configured in terms of the pad this was due to the fact that the port to the console version was handled by another studio, with which we do not collaborate on a daily basis. But I have some good news for you - as you may have noticed, we are improving the pad on the PC version, and we are working on it on the console version as well - and programming is handled by our House Builder programmers from the Steam version! This will allow us to release the same version of the game on consoles as on PC. This will ensure that many players who don't have PCs will have as much fun as Steam players! We'll keep you updated. In collaboration with our friends from Play2Chill who are making the unique game Aztecs The Last Sun we have prepared an Aztec house for you! You will be able to feel like in the old good days, when Aztec culture was a total mystery to European travellers.
Game now have 20% off!

Indian culture at one time was highly developed - their technologies were so advanced that to this day scientists and historians marvel at the inventions and buildings that were built in those years. We have tried to take care of the tiniest detail to make the imersion and satisfaction of the game as great as possible for you, and to make you feel literally as if you were in the time of the Aztecs building the pyramids!🏠
Most famous Aztec pyramid was built almost a thousand years ago! 🏗️

We want to bring you as much fun as possible, so we are giving you the next update - Roman House Update! Game now have 20% off!

The Roman Empire was once a great power - they conquered vast territories that covered most of Europe area and the northern part of Africa! Have you ever wondered what a Roman villa looked like? The Romans took care of every detail, so it was very refined, aesthetically pleasing and often had innovative technologies such as the Hypocaustum, which was the forerunner of underfloor heating. In this level, we will introduce you to the appearance of the ancient villa and techniques you had no idea about!🏠

releases.displayName: Medieval Farmhouse Update! - Bundle with Castle Flipper

items.text: Today, we are starting interesting bundle with our friends from Pyramid Games
Castle Flipper!
On this occasion, we have an update for you - Medieval Farmhouse🏘️ - we encourage you to buy our bundle and save money!

If you have already played Farmhouse, but you haven't experienced the medieval version, now is the perfect time to do so. You will be transported to the countryside, where you will experience the idyllic nature and construction, which is only used in houses inspired by past times.
You will also become acquainted with retro objects that are no longer to be found in today's countryside - lanterns, wells, carriages and much more! We know you're ready for this
journey - the house can be found in present-day Spain. So let's get to it!🏠
Do you like Retro houses? 🙂🏗️

Today, our friends from Pyramid Games are releasing their survival simulation game Occupy Mars: The Game!
On this occasion, we have an update for you - house on Mars!🏘️ - we encourage you to buy our bundle and save money!

The colonisation of other planets has interested humans for many years - is it possible to live somewhere other than Earth? Let's hurry up with the answer - in our game, absolutely yes! You will learn the secrets of building a house and the first colony on Mars. You will also fly a jetpack, garden in dedicated greenhouse and much, much more! The launch point for the mission to Mars is in Mexico, so
if you want to be the first builder on the other planet look for the spot in that area🏠
Will we see you on Mars? 🙂🏗️

We surprised you with two new houses recently - we have no plans to stop. As of today, we are releasing a new level - Tropical House!🏘️

Have you ever imagined what would happen if you were camped in a wild jungle? How would you have to behave to survive until help arrived? Now you will know the answer! You have found yourself on a deserted island in the Atlantic Ocean - your task is not only to build a house in a huge tree in order to survive, but also to build a sign that will draw attention of potencial rescuers. You will also find various secrets on the island - we advise you to explore it carefully!🏠

items.text: Today another update with fixed bugs for you! I would also like to announce that a big update is coming soon - wait patiently! OK, then back to today's update, lets go:
The bug that caused doors to mount themselves in sandbox mode, without having to buy them, has been removed;
Thanks to your reports we fixed the bug in which you were run down of some items, even if there was needed less than you have stocked;
There is no longer a black screen appearing after a quick enter and exit of the level before the welcoming screen;
When you click the sense that is activated by letter Z, it already highlights the grass to interact with;
Fixed a bug where a white light would appear when stacking pipes, making it difficult to complete the task;
Fixed a bug in which already installed pipes weren't saved;
Fixed a bug where the game crashed when pressing the ESC button simultaneously during a pop-up message, such as changing graphics settings;

From now on, when reporting bugs, you can enter your e-mail! This will make it easy for us to contact you and fix the bugs you have experienced. Feel free to use this option under the 'REPORT BUG' tab in the game;
The 'Creative Mode' house has been removed from the map - from now on, just switch to Creative Mode from 'CREATIVE MODE' from the game's main menu;
Fixed a bug with items not appearing on the map, for example the paddle on the Mud House - thank you for your reports!;
